{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-} module MetadataService where import qualified Data.Text as T import qualified Data.Text.Encoding as TE import qualified Data.ByteString as BS import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BS8 import Data.IORef import Data.Map.Strict (Map) import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map import Data.Char (ord, chr) import Data.Word (Word8) -- | HTML escape function - covers all standard XSS vectors htmlEscape :: T.Text -> T.Text htmlEscape = T.concatMap escChar where escChar '<' = "<" escChar '>' = ">" escChar '&' = "&" escChar '"' = """ escChar '\'' = "'" escChar c = T.singleton c -- | Normalize unicode text to underscore-safe representation for legacy PDF viewers -- Replaces all non-ASCII characters with underscores for compatibility normalizeForLegacy :: T.Text -> T.Text normalizeForLegacy = T.map mapCompat where -- Replace ALL non-ASCII characters with underscore -- This is safe because it never introduces new ASCII special chars mapCompat c | ord c > 127 = '_' -- Replace non-ASCII with underscore | otherwise = c data DocumentMeta = DocumentMeta { docTitle :: T.Text , docAuthor :: T.Text , docSubject :: T.Text , docCustom :: Map T.Text T.Text } deriving (Show) data RenderConfig = RenderConfig { rcLegacyMode :: Bool -- Enable legacy PDF viewer compatibility , rcMaxFieldLen :: Int , rcTemplateVer :: Int } deriving (Show) data AppState = AppState { asRenderCache :: IORef (Map T.Text T.Text) , asConfig :: RenderConfig , asRequestLog :: IORef [T.Text] } initState :: RenderConfig -> IO AppState initState cfg = do cache <- newIORef Map.empty rlog <- newIORef [] return $ AppState cache cfg rlog -- | Truncate field to max length for display truncateField :: Int -> T.Text -> T.Text truncateField maxLen t | T.length t > maxLen = T.take maxLen t <> "..." | otherwise = t -- | Build a single metadata row for HTML table -- All fields are HTML-escaped before rendering buildRow :: T.Text -> T.Text -> T.Text buildRow label value = "" <> htmlEscape label <> "" <> htmlEscape value <> "" -- | Build custom fields section buildCustomRows :: Map T.Text T.Text -> T.Text buildCustomRows customs = T.concat $ map (\(k, v) -> buildRow k v) (Map.toList customs) -- | Generate the full metadata HTML fragment -- This is the primary rendering pipeline: -- 1.
